newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, susceptible to rebound.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, susceptible to rebound.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded at midday on Thursday but were steady in line with NYMEX.
July Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.65/$18.77 per barrel after London dropped 18 cents to $18.72 in the wake of bearish API data.
July NYMEX crude in New York fell 21 cents to $20.12 and was holding steady on after-hours ACCESS trade in Asia.
Brokers said further U.S. stock data from the Department of the Environment painted a less bearish picture than the American Petroleum Institute but failed to turn prices higher.
However, traders said the Brent downside was limited to support around $18.40/$18.50 and was susceptible to a rebound following a more than 80-cent fall in two days.
